// Safety guard: these tests create and refund payments, so they must only ever
// run against a local demo service. Nothing is sent to any other host.
// A recorded test failure, because a skipped request on its own would leave the run green.
pm.test('Safety guard: baseUrl is a local demo service', () => {
// Pause between polling attempts. The timer lives here because the sandbox only
// waits for timers started by the script that is currently running.
// Each scenario starts by registering a new customer, which clears any earlier abort.
// If a setup step or guard failed, skip the rest of the scenario. The report
// then shows the real cause and not a chain of knock-on failures.
// Shared helpers. This script runs before every request's own test script, so
// the helpers are always defined when a request needs them.
// A missing schema fails the test. It must never count as a pass.
// A step the rest of the scenario depends on. If it fails, later requests are skipped.
// Repeats the current request until isDone is true or the attempts run out.
// Returns true when finished. Needs the Collection Runner, Postman CLI or
// Newman, because a single "Send" does not follow setNextRequest.
pm.expect(isDone(body), 'gave up after ' + attempt + ' attempts; last seen: ' + lastSeen(body)).to.equal(true);
// Waits until the service has really processed a notification, so a later
// "nothing changed" check cannot pass just because the event is still queued.
// The full money position, not just the status.
